name: @tazor/pay
description: Tazor payment links, payment watching and a <tazor-pay-button> web component for USDT on Whitechain.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --target=es2022 --alias:viem=./node_modules/viem --outfile=dist/index.js && esbuild src/iife.ts --bundle --format=iife --platform=browser --target=es2020 --minify --alias:viem=./node_modules/viem --outfile=dist/tazor-pay.js
